description:
FREE: declare a progressively published series. aggregate: mean (prices), sum (totals), share (survival/success 0/1 per
    slot), last (closing value). n_expected: number of observation slots in the period. value_min/value_max: the physical
    bounds of one observation; without them nothing is decided until the period is complete (S5).

meta.description: Optional. Extra description of the series.
meta.title: Meta

n_expected.description: Number of observation slots in the period.
n_expected.title: N Expected

strikes.description: Optional. Values of interest for the aggregate.
strikes.title: Strikes

unit.description: Unit of one observation, for example USD or percent.
unit.title: Unit

value_max.description: Optional. Highest physically possible value of one observation.
value_max.title: Value Max

value_min.description: Optional. Lowest physically possible value of one observation.
value_min.title: Value Min

name: register_series
title: Register series
